query:
SELECT c.world_id, c.id AS conversation_id,
                   item.message AS "message!: Json<Message>"
            FROM conversations c
            CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(c.messages) AS item(message)
            WHERE c.world_id = $1
            AND c.user_id = $2
            AND item.message->>'id' = $3::text
            LIMIT 1
